H03-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  STRFTIME('%Y-%m', issued_date) AS month, 
  SUM(amount_usd) AS monthly_invoice, 
  SUM(SUM(amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY issued_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
FROM 
  invoices
WHERE 
  STRFTIME('%Y', issued_date) = '2025'
GROUP BY 
  month
ORDER BY 
  month;
```

H03-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  STRFTIME('%Y-%m', issued_date) AS month, 
  SUM(amount_usd) AS total_amount, 
  SUM(SUM(amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY issued_date) AS running_total
FROM 
  invoices
WHERE 
  STRFTIME('%Y', issued_date) = '2025'
GROUP BY 
  month
ORDER BY 
  month;
```

H03-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', issued_date) AS month, 
  SUM(amount_usd) AS billed_revenue, 
  SUM(SUM(amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', issued_date)) AS ytd_cumulative_revenue
FROM 
  invoices
WHERE 
  strftime('%Y', issued_date) = '2025'
GROUP BY 
  month
ORDER BY 
  month;
```

H04-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure) AS month,
  COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flights_completed,
  LAG(COUNT(f.flight_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure)) - COUNT(f.flight_id) AS change_from_previous_month
FROM 
  flights f
WHERE 
  f.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
  strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure)
ORDER BY 
  month;
```

H04-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS completed_flights,
  LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure)) - COUNT(*) AS difference_to_previous_month
FROM 
  flights
WHERE 
  status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
  strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure)
ORDER BY 
  month;
```

H04-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure) AS month,
  SUM(fc.total_weight_kg) AS total_volume_kg,
  LAG(SUM(fc.total_weight_kg)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure)) AS previous_month_volume_kg,
  (SUM(fc.total_weight_kg) - LAG(SUM(fc.total_weight_kg)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure))) / LAG(SUM(fc.total_weight_kg)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure)) AS month_over_month_change
FROM 
  flights f
JOIN 
  flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id
WHERE 
  f.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
  month
ORDER BY 
  month;
```

H04-VAG.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  SUBSTR(scheduled_departure, 1, 7) AS month, 
  COUNT(*) AS flight_count 
FROM 
  flights 
GROUP BY 
  month 
ORDER BY 
  month;
```

H05-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT a.tail_number, AVG(julianday(f2.actual_arrival) - julianday(f1.actual_arrival)) AS avg_ground_time
FROM aircraft a
JOIN flights f1 ON a.aircraft_id = f1.aircraft_id AND f1.status = 'completed'
JOIN flights f2 ON a.aircraft_id = f2.aircraft_id AND f2.status = 'completed' AND f2.flight_id > f1.flight_id
GROUP BY a.tail_number
ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

H05-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT a.tail_number, AVG(julianday(f.actual_departure) - julianday(t.event_time)) AS avg_time_diff
FROM aircraft a
JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id
JOIN tracking_events t ON f.flight_id = t.flight_id AND t.event_code = 'DEP'
WHERE f.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY a.tail_number
ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

H05-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT a.tail_number, AVG(julianday(f2.actual_arrival) - julianday(f1.actual_arrival)) AS avg_turnaround
FROM aircraft a
JOIN flights f1 ON a.aircraft_id = f1.aircraft_id AND f1.status = 'completed'
JOIN flights f2 ON a.aircraft_id = f2.aircraft_id AND f2.status = 'completed' AND f2.flight_id > f1.flight_id
GROUP BY a.tail_number
ORDER BY avg_turnaround ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

H05-VAG.raw:
```sql
SELECT AVG(julianday(flights.actual_arrival) - julianday(flights.scheduled_departure)) AS avg_turnaround_time
FROM flights
WHERE flights.status = 'completed';
```

H06-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT c.name, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS total_invoiced, (SUM(i.amount_usd) / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices)) * 100 AS share
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING total_invoiced > (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) * 0.04 FROM invoices);
```

H06-SCH.raw:
```sql

FROM customers c
JOIN shipments s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
JOIN invoices i ON s.shipment_id = i.shipment_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING percentage > 0.04;
```

